materials.name: Dark carbon steering wheel - supported by original CAD cover

motionReport.geometryPolicy: Original connected CAD meshes and material slots; object transforms only.
motionReport.seekPolicy: Absolute transforms from saved source matrices; source pose at progress 0 and 1.
motionReport.motion: Steering wheel, three individually coaxial shaft segments and both pairs of universal-joint yokes drive the horizontal rack.
motionReport.directionChoice: A clockwise 90-degree stroke and return, measured from the source neutral wheel pose. The complete negative stroke does not deepen the original upper-yoke interference; the opposite stroke is not used.
motionReport.previousRangeReason: The former 32-degree stroke was a conservatively checked display range, not a CAD hard stop. Extending the existing negative stroke to 90 degrees retains the original parts, shaft centers, and contact geometry without assembly corrections.
motionReport.limitations: The supplied CAD omits separate universal-joint cross pins and internal rack teeth. The source yokes remain intact; Cardan phase coupling and rack travel illustrate their function, without claiming a calibrated steering ratio.

limitations: Sampled source poses; interpolation does not imply measured engineering time.
